messages:
maya: quick q — how strictly should the runtime enforce schema for streaming NDJSON partials? e.g., if we stream object-per-line, some lines may be incomplete if truncated. are clients supposed to tolerate missing fields? :thinking:

ben: short answer: servers should emit only complete JSON objects per line. if truncation happens we should signal with a final sentinel event. prob need a tiny spec + examples.

alex: are we standardizing on `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson` vs `text/event-stream` for structured outputs? which one do we recommend for new endpoints?

sasha: prefer application/x-ndjson for object-per-line. runtime currently sends `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8`. if we hit a soft fallback we sometimes send a final partial object like \{\"_partial\": true, \"error\": \"truncated\"\} — is that acceptable?

maya: consumers prefer a schema-stable envelope. i'd rather we define an explicit `status` field and make `payload` nullable. avoid ad-hoc top-level keys unless documented.

ben: propose this minimal schema for each NDJSON line:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": { "enum": ["ok","partial","error"] },
    "payload": { "type": ["object","null"] },
    "errors": { "type": ["array","null"], "items": { "type": "string" } }
  },
  "required": ["status"]
}
```

alex: +1. consumers can parse `status` first and short-circuit. if `status==\"partial\"` treat payload as nullable/unstable. this avoids surprising schema changes.

schema-bot: lint result: streaming-ndjson-schema.yaml: PASS (no breaking changes) :white_check_mark:

sasha: runtime note: when we fallback to a smaller model we currently send `status: \"partial\"` with `payload` containing best-effort tokens. need to ensure token-level truncation doesn't break JSON framing (i.e., never emit half a line).

maya: action items: ben -> add schema doc in docs/api/streaming.md; alex -> add header enforcement + parse tests in js-sdk; sasha -> runtime guard to avoid emitting half-lines and emit explicit final `status` object on fallback. can we aim EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

ben: will open a PR and link here.

alex: i'll add a quick unit + integration test in js-sdk to assert Content-Type header and that parsing short-circuits on `status`.

maya: thanks all :rocket:
